description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lantern of Insight.
Cast Lantern of Insight from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Glaring Fleshraker
Mirran Spy and Glaring Fleshraker trigger
Resolve the Mirran Spy trigger, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating an Eldrazi Spawn token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Lantern of Insight by tapping and sacrificing it, causing target player to shuffle their library.
Repeat.
